alignments.note: Construct noun cannot take the article; the supplied English the belongs to the noun it determines.
Rule 19: the of of the construct chain belongs to the nomen rectum.
Surface and lemma give Mahanaim here; the segment glosses are distributed in reverse (rule 39).
The directive he is the only morpheme licensing the English preposition, so it takes in; attaching in to Mahanaim and marking the he unrepresented remains defensible.
